comment: Paired sequences and receptor origins: Supplementary Table 3. Reconstructed receptors use mouse constant regions; species records the variable-region origin. Peptide-loaded HLA-A*11:01 K562 assays are distinguished from endogenous-antigen recognition. Naive blood CD8 T cells were peptide-expanded, tetramer-sorted as single cells and sequenced by nested RT-PCR/Sanger. The paper does not explicitly map each clone to the HD donor labels; donor ID and frequency remain unset. RAB7B peptide reactivity is reported in Figure 3D/E, including responses at high peptide concentration; no endogenous-RAB7B recognition is inferred.
